comment: The identity that installers, the Store and signed releases carry. It is permanent after the first Store or signed release (REL-031), so it changes only by owner decision D-03 and in this file, the test of scripts/release/release-records.test.ts, electron-builder.yml and package.json together.
decision: D-03 is decided (owner, 2026-10-20): the product and the desktop application are called ZPLC. The reverse-DNS root com.zenithindustrialcloud assumes the project is published under the owner's company domain; the owner confirms it before the first signed or Store release, the alternative being io.github.eduardojvieira.zplc. No Store or signed release exists yet, so these identifiers can still change.
